title: Guardian Policy Publications Log
description: JSON Schema for publications.json, the append-only log of Hedera publication events for one policy. Written only by scripts/record-publication.js.

policy_id.description: The id of the sibling policy.yml.

entries.description: One entry per publish event, oldest first.

network.description: Hedera network the publish message was submitted to. A consensus timestamp exists on exactly one network.

hedera_timestamp.description: Consensus timestamp (seconds.nanoseconds) of the Guardian publish-policy message. Quoted string, never a number.

version.description: Policy version carried by the publish message.

hedera_topic_id.description: Instance topic of this publication. Each publish creates a new one.
